title: queue/routing: find_header_end logic duplicated 3 times
description: The CRLF-CRLF header-boundary window scan appears independently in queue.rs (find_header_end), routing.rs (add_newsgroups_header inline scan), and at least one other site. Three copies of the same 4-byte window logic. Extract to a shared function in stoa-core or a queue::util module.
